<mxfile host="drawio" version="24.7.17"> <diagram id="job-lifecycle" name="Training job lifecycle"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="1400" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="1400" background="#FFFFFF" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" value="Kayra: from an uploaded file to a deployable model" style="text;html=0;fontSize=20;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#1A1A19;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="0" width="700" height="34" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_upload" value="1. Upload a data file,
or add an S3 source" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="50" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_ingest" value="2. Ingestion API (POST /api/ingestion/...)
/upload saves the file as <uuid>.<ext> in UPLOAD_DIR;
/database registers an S3 path instead.
Adds a data_sources row, ingestion pending" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="50" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s_files" value="Dataset files
uploads: UPLOAD_DIR folder
S3 sources: read in place" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="50" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_ingtask" value="3. ingest_data_task (Celery worker or in-process)
Polars connector reads the file or S3 object;
DataProfiler stores schema, row count and profile;
ingestion completed, or failed with the error" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFE9C7;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="180" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s_db" value="SQL database
SQLite (default) or PostgreSQL" style="shape=cylinder3;html=0;boundedLbl=1;size=8;fillColor=#F5F5F5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="185" width="220" height="70" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_canvas" value="4. Build the pipeline on
the canvas, then Run
(nodes, params, inputs)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=13;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="330" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_run" value="5. Run endpoint POST /api/pipeline/run
resolves each dataset id to a file path or S3 options;
leakage check (on_leakage is raise by default)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="330" width="420" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f_reject" value="Rejected (HTTP 400 or 404)
leakage found, bad graph
or unknown dataset;
no job is created" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="330" width="220" height="76" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_jobs" value="6. Jobs created (JobManager)
graph split into branches, one training_jobs row each:
status queued, next version number per dataset + model;
a repeated click gets the already active job back" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="456" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_runner" value="7. Job runner
in-process threads via BackgroundTasks (default)
or a Celery worker through Redis (USE_CELERY=true)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFE9C7;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="586" width="420" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_exec" value="8. execute_pipeline (run_pipeline_task)
job status running; artifact store: local folder or S3;
builds the data catalog: Polars frames by default
(SKYULF_ENGINE=pandas switches the engine)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="700" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="b_ws" value="Realtime job events
WebSocket /ws/jobs to the canvas
(Redis pub/sub with Celery,
in-process bus without)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="700" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_engine" value="9. PipelineEngine.run
cycle check, then the leakage check again;
runs nodes in topological order;
stops at the first failed node" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="830" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c_core" value="skyulf-core
FeatureEngineer (preprocessing)
StatefulEstimator, tuning
SklearnBridge" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#EAF7EE;strokeColor=#82B366;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="830" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_art" value="Artifacts
bundle under the job id:
feature_engineer + model;
reference data for drift" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="760" y="830" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="f_failed" value="Job failed
status failed and an
error_message on the row
(node error or exception)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FDECEC;strokeColor=#B85450;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="20" y="970" width="220" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_done" value="10. Job completed
training_jobs row: status completed, progress 100,
metrics and artifact_uri" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#F3E8FF;strokeColor=#9673A6;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="970" width="420" height="64" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_registry" value="11. Model registry GET /api/registry/models
lists every completed job as a version" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="1084" width="420" height="56" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="a_deploy" value="12. Deploy POST /api/deployment/deploy/{job_id}
completed jobs only; the bundle must load;
the new deployments row becomes active and
the previous one is switched off (one active)" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fillColor=#FFF4E5;strokeColor=#D79B00;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="1190" width="420" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="o_predict" value="13. Prediction API POST /api/deployment/predict
the active bundle: feature_engineer transforms
